conclusion: Private Arena04 layout/reset changes require rebuilding the proc-macro client library and dependent proc-macro dylibs, but the inspected unchanged bridge wire does not require a rustc server rebuild. This is a source-level compatibility conclusion for the matched sources, not an arbitrary-version ABI guarantee or an execution/distribution qualification.
